title: My Objects
lead: Turn a real thing into a math sticker. Photos stay on this device.
empty: No stickers yet. Add a crayon, pencil, or die to begin.
sessionOnly: Storage is session-only on this device.
deviceOnly: Photos stay on this device. Class sharing is off.
captureTips: Plain background and good light work best. One object at a time. Fill the frame.
cutoutFail: We could not cut that photo out. Try again with a plainer background.
faceBlocked: Let’s take a picture of an object, not a person.
name_person: Please name the object, not a person.
name_digits: Please name the object without numbers.
storageFull: Your object library is full. Delete one to add another.
grownUpLead: A grown-up should tap to allow the camera for your own object photos.
cameraClassOff: Your teacher has not turned on object photos for this class yet. You can still use the starter pack.
